sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: biomarkers_list
# Select paper and measured biomarkers
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?biomarker ?biomarkerLabel
WHERE {
  # Link paper to its contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  # Restrict to this template contribution class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C123091 .
  # Biomarkers reported by the study
  ?contribution orkgp:P192000 ?biomarker .
  # Paper title
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Biomarker label
  OPTIONAL { ?biomarker rdfs:label ?biomarkerLabel }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: measurement_method_per_paper
# List each paper with the measurement method it reports
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?measurement ?measurementLabel ?measurementName
WHERE {
  # Paper to its own contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  # Contribution to the process-group hop
  ?paperContribution orkgp:P7108 ?hop1 .
  # Relations that reach process-step instances
  VALUES ?link2 { orkgp:P43070 orkgp:P44026 orkgp:P44027 }
  ?hop1 ?link2 ?contribution .
  # Restrict to this template class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C21032 .
  # Measurement method reported by the step
  ?contribution orkgp:P44012 ?measurement .
  # Paper title
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Resource label of the measurement method
  OPTIONAL { ?measurement rdfs:label ?measurementLabel }
  # Nested name of the measurement method
  OPTIONAL { ?measurement orkgp:P7111 ?nameNode . OPTIONAL { ?nameNode rdfs:label ?measurementName } }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: matrix_per_paper
# Each paper with the has matrix entity it reports
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?matrix ?matrixLabel
WHERE {
  # Paper to its own contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  # Contribution to the variable hop
  ?paperContribution orkgp:P135056 ?hop1 .
  # Relations that reach Variable instances
  VALUES ?link2 { orkgp:P27012 orkgp:P27011 }
  ?hop1 ?link2 ?contribution .
  # Restrict to this template class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C67003 .
  # Has matrix entity reported by the variable
  ?contribution orkgp:P117006 ?matrix .
  # Paper title
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Human readable matrix label
  OPTIONAL { ?matrix rdfs:label ?matrixLabel }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>

PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: algorithm_per_paper
# Each paper with the machine learning algorithms it reports
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?algorithm ?algorithmLabel
WHERE {
  # Paper to its own contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  # Contribution to the machine learning hop
  ?paperContribution orkgp:P15124 ?hop1 .
  # Hop to the Machine Learning template instance
  ?hop1 orkgp:P57016 ?contribution .
  # Restrict to this template class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C29012 .
  # Algorithm reported by the publication
  ?contribution orkgp:P2001 ?algorithm .
  # Paper title
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Human readable algorithm label
  OPTIONAL { ?algorithm rdfs:label ?algorithmLabel }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: zeta_potential_value_per_paper
# Each paper with the zeta potential value it reports
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?value ?valueLabel
WHERE {
  # Paper to its own contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  # Contribution to the zeta potential instance
  ?paperContribution orkgp:P37298 ?contribution .
  # Restrict to this template class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C20047 .
  # Zeta potential value reported
  ?contribution orkgp:HAS_VALUE ?value .
  # Paper title
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Literal value label when present
  OPTIONAL { ?value rdfs:label ?valueLabel }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: quantity_value_unit_per_paper
# Each paper with the qudt:unit of the quantity values it reports
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?unit ?unitLabel ?unitUcum
WHERE {
  # Paper to its own contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  # All relations that reach Quantity Value instances
  VALUES ?link1 { orkgp:P142035 orkgp:P175001 orkgp:P175002 orkgp:P147063 orkgp:P31 }
  ?paperContribution ?link1 ?contribution .
  # Restrict to this template class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C67005 .
  # qudt:unit linked to the quantity value
  ?contribution orkgp:P118088 ?unit .
  # Paper title
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Human readable unit label
  OPTIONAL { ?unit rdfs:label ?unitLabel }
  # UCUM code of the unit when available
  OPTIONAL { ?unit orkgp:P45081 ?unitUcum }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>

# id: first_prize_per_paper
# Each paper with the first prize (winning system) it reports
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?firstPrize ?firstPrizeLabel
WHERE {
  # Paper to its own contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  # Relations that reach SemTab challenge instances
  VALUES ?link1 { orkgp:P15370 orkgp:P97167 }
  ?paperContribution ?link1 ?contribution .
  # Restrict to this template class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C52000 .
  # First prize system reported by the challenge instance
  ?contribution orkgp:P97102 ?firstPrize .
  # Paper title
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Human readable system label
  OPTIONAL { ?firstPrize rdfs:label ?firstPrizeLabel }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: text_value_per_paper
# Each paper with the textValue of its evaluation items
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?textValue
WHERE {
  # Paper to its own contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  # Contribution to the evaluation hop
  ?paperContribution orkgp:P37365 ?hop1 .
  # Hop to the Evaluation item instance
  ?hop1 orkgp:P71154 ?contribution .
  # Restrict to this template class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C40018 .
  # textValue reported by the evaluation item
  ?contribution orkgp:P71153 ?textValue .
  # Paper title
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: studied_by_per_paper
# Each paper with the research field that studies the hypotheses it reports
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?studiedBy ?studiedByLabel
WHERE {
  # Paper to its own contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  # Direct relations reaching hypothesis instances
  {
    VALUES ?link1 { orkgp:P30001 orkgp:P95001 orkgp:P29013 }
    ?paperContribution ?link1 ?contribution .
  }
  UNION
  # Two hop variants used by the remaining instances
  {
    ?paperContribution ?hopLink ?hop .
    ?hop ?contributionLink ?contribution .
  }
  # Restrict to this template class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C65014 .
  # Research field that studies the hypothesis
  ?contribution orkgp:wikidata:P2579 ?studiedBy .
  # Paper title
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Human readable research field label
  OPTIONAL { ?studiedBy rdfs:label ?studiedByLabel }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: measures_of_position_per_paper
# Each paper with the measures of position reported in its descriptive statistics
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?positionMeasure ?positionMeasureLabel ?boxplot
WHERE {
  # Paper to its own contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  # Contribution to the descriptive statistics hop
  ?paperContribution orkgp:P15124 ?hop1 .
  # Hop to the Descriptive Statistics instance
  ?hop1 orkgp:P56048 ?contribution .
  # Restrict to this template class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C20073 .
  # Measures of position subtemplate
  ?contribution orkgp:P57010 ?positionMeasure .
  # Boxplot flag reported inside the subtemplate
  OPTIONAL { ?positionMeasure orkgp:P59065 ?boxplot }
  # Paper title
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Human readable label of the position measure
  OPTIONAL { ?positionMeasure rdfs:label ?positionMeasureLabel }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: venue_per_paper
# Each paper described by the Paper template with the venue it reports
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?venue ?venueLabel
WHERE {
  # Restrict to Paper template instances
  ?paper a orkgc:Paper .
  # Venue reported by the paper
  ?paper orkgp:HAS_VENUE ?venue .
  # Paper title
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Human readable venue label
  OPTIONAL { ?venue rdfs:label ?venueLabel }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: has_measurement_per_paper
# Each paper with the plasma measurements reported under its qualities
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?measurement ?measurementLabel ?measurementText
WHERE {
  # Paper to its own contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  # Contribution to the Qualities instance
  ?paperContribution orkgp:P43078 ?contribution .
  # Restrict to this template class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C21038 .
  # Has measurement directly or nested through has quality chains
  ?contribution orkgp:P7113* ?quality .
  ?quality orkgp:P41861 ?measurement .
  # Paper title
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
  # Human readable measurement label
  OPTIONAL { ?measurement rdfs:label ?measurementLabel }
  # Free text description of the measurement
  OPTIONAL { ?measurement orkgp:P52041 ?measurementText }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
# id: rmse_per_paper
# Each paper with the root mean square error it reports
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?rmse ?rmseUnit
WHERE {
  # Paper to its own contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  # Route through the method branch
  {
    ?paperContribution orkgp:METHOD ?hop1 .
    ?hop1 orkgp:P42007 ?contribution .
  }
  UNION
  # Route through the result branch
  {
    ?paperContribution orkgp:RESULT ?hop1 .
    ?hop1 orkgp:P67040 ?contribution .
  }
  # Restrict to this template class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C40028 .
  # Root mean square error value
  ?contribution orkgp:P62075 ?rmse .
  # Unit of the error value
  OPTIONAL { ?contribution orkgp:P42000 ?rmseUnit }
  # Paper title
  ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel .
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel
